highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 fixes glyph-atlas tracking and shared-stencil clear coordinates.

bullets.detail: Tracks shared Ganesh stencil-clear bounds in backend-native coordinates so render targets with different origins do not reuse an uncleared region.
Limits generation updates to the regenerated glyph subrun, avoiding reuse of atlas locations for glyphs that may have been evicted.
The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: The bundled Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged; unrelated pre-existing BinSkim warnings remain.
